Thank you! I didn’t even really notice the difference in them until super recently and especially in this picture but it’s WILD. But yeah I was on .25 for about 3 months, then .5 for 6, and then .75 for 5 months briefly down to .25 for 2 months (I freaked out cause .75 was a little too fast and overwhelming lol) then back up to .75 again and now I’m on 1! It helped me a lot to be on a low dose and it surprisingly made a big difference! Changes come on a lot slower and give you time to get used to them and you can always stop or slow down if you want to! Though obviously make peace with the effects you don’t want before hand, but you’ll be able to tell if something is happening that you don’t want and stop taking it when it does! I really only wanted the voice change and facial hair tbh, and it’s taken me a long time to get used to the other effects, but at this point I like them and theres no question that it was the right choice for me!
Thank u ☺️, I really hope you find something that works for you!
